mechanisms.rationale: One atomic fail-loud contract — scan the parsed `gates:` map's top-level keys and guard value shapes (unrecognized key / known-key-with-map / null / scalar / array), emitting self-contained console.error stderr diagnostics — all lands in the single code file in the touch set (loader.ts readGatesConfig), with a real production proof surface (`quay gate --list` via listGates -> loadWorkspaceGates -> readGatesConfig; MCP gate_list; any workspace-declared-gate invocation). The shape-guard variants are call-site variants of one behavior contract, not independently valuable mechanisms (the null guard only exists because the scan adds Object.keys); the new test file and KNOWN_GATE_SECTIONS const are proof/inputs of this mechanism, not separate mechanisms. Independent of DIR-100-B (per-entry validation) and deliberately does NOT consume DIR-100-C's channel.
